real_defects.issue: VALARM TRIGGER regex made every component optional, so TRIGGER:P and TRIGGER:-PT (no number) passed as valid durations. Fixed with DUR_RE requiring a number; test: 'an empty duration is not a valid VALARM TRIGGER'.

Enumerated values compared case-sensitively: RRULE:freq=monthly;byday=2tu raised 'unknown FREQ' plus a false BYDAY error, and DTSTART;VALUE=date with a time escaped the VALUE=DATE check (RFC 5545 2.1 says case-insensitive). parseRrule and VALUE params are upper-cased now.
An event DURATION was never validated: DURATION:1 hour and DURATION:-PT1H passed. Now an error with a valid example.
repair() rewrote an all-day DTEND from parsed params without re-quoting, so X-NOTE="a:b" became X-NOTE=a:b and the repaired file had a new 'bad DTEND' error. paramText re-quotes values holding : ; ,

Ten .ics generators emit SUMMARY/DESCRIPTION lines over 75 octets without folding (RFC 5545 3.1 SHOULD): wedding-day-timeline-builder (235), state-residency-day-counter (217), subscription-audit-from-statement (152), severance-package-calculator (128), patent-maintenance-fee-planner (111), business-insurance-policy-reader (105), vendor-contract-clause-reader (96), saas-renewal-planner (91), coi-expiry-gap-checker (85), commercial-lease-abstract-reader (76). Warning-level only. Fix: fold each output with a fold helper (copy ics-calendar-check/calc.mjs fold(), octet-aware), then tighten ventures/ics-calendar-check/dogfood.test.mjs clean() to also reject the 'longer than 75 octets' warning. Left open: ten products' outputs and tests in one run was too wide after the four checker fixes.
